messages:
Maya: Quick sync: customer asks for a 90-day pinned model for a new translate family. They want performance SLAs and a clear migration/rollback window. Can we ship this on Hosted?
Devon: A hard 90d pin on Hosted is risky without reserved capacity. Options: offer a paid reserved pool, a Dedicated Lite SKU, or a soft-pin with credits + strict monitoring.
Alejandro: They specifically asked for p95 < 300ms at 512 tokens and 99.9% uptime. Also need embedding batch runs off-peak.
Lina: Product options scoped:
- Soft-pin: catalog pin + 30d grace, auto-migrate after notice.
- Paid-pin: 90d guaranteed pin with reserved pool; customer pays premium.
- Canary-first: two successful canaries then optional extension.
Devon: Infra note: reserving capacity for a few customers fragments our pools and raises unit costs. Need infra cost delta and quantization profile impact on latency.
ops-bot: Proposed bench scoring: score = 0.5*latency_norm + 0.3*quality_norm + 0.2*stability_norm. GA gate: score >= 0.78 and no regressions >2% on critical prompts.
Maya: Product proposal: ship Paid-pin as an add-on behind Reserved-Pool or Dedicated Lite. SLA example: p95 <= 350ms, 99.95% uptime, 10 business days migration notice, 90d pin billed. Soft-pin remains free with 30d grace.
Alejandro: Launch gating must include: 3 customer canaries OR 1 large customer + 2 internal canaries; full bench suite (perf + 10 prompt regressions + embedding consistency); rollback playbook.
Devon: Actions: Eng to provide cost delta + latency tradeoffs; Product to draft pricing & addendum; CS to collect customer traffic patterns and acceptance criteria.
Maya: Timeline: draft offer + bench spec by EOW next sprint. Do not enable hard pins until telemetry and regression alerts are live.
Lina: I'll start the spec and bench matrix. @Alejandro can you share sample datasets?
Alejandro: Uploading sample sets to /mnt/onboard/pin-canary now.
Devon: If infra flags capacity concerns we default to paid-pin + canary only. I'll get quota and cost numbers.
ops-bot: Dev preview canary config suggestion:
```
canary_config:
  mode: reserved
  duration_days: 14
  traffic_split: 5%
```
Alejandro: Recommend auto-unpin safety after 90d unless renewed.
Lina: Will add auto-unpin + renewal workflow.
Maya: Short sync Thurs after cost estimates. Saving notes to spec and will create roadmap thread when costs/bench are ready.
